findings.text: The refit table records one calibration row changing route, but the artifact the refit wrote moves five: cascade_thresholds.json docs route_counts accept 195 -> 200 and refine 15 -> 10, and the paragraph below the table itself says the veto count falls by the five calibration rows the old scorer froze at 0.0. The recorded before/after figure contradicts both the artifact and the surrounding prose.

The fragment (and the run manifest) states that nine of the twelve re-frozen rows sat at exactly 0.0. Recomputing the base and head columns of srtj-jev-vs-panel-operating-point.json shows 12 of 386 rows changed and 7 of those were 0.0 at the base revision (21 docs rows read 0.0 in the base column). The count of zeros does not reproduce.

The restored strip_dd_prefix on the contradiction note's binding labels has no assertion that fails if it is removed: the two note tests in tests/standard_names/test_veto_all_bindings.py:201 and :235 inject strip_dd_prefix as the identity lambda, so a regression back to the unstripped labels leaves both green.
